ValidationRule.description: V-OUT-06: Requires both Planned Exit Date and Confirmed Exit Date to be populated before the case can progress past ASA In Progress stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Outgoing_Exchange', NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'ASA In Progress')), OR(ISBLANK(Planned_Exit_Date__c), ISBLANK(Confirmed_Exit_Date__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Both Planned Exit Date and Confirmed Exit Date are required before the case can progress.
